summary: New phone-first page that replaces the 2026 Word run book: a first-five lineup card, the season in order with 2027 dates marked coming soon, the three clearance steps, tap-to-open chapters on teams, rules and GameChanger, a copy-ready family email, uniforms and gear, a new safety section and a who-to-ask directory.
blurb: A phone-friendly coach run book to replace the Word document.

sources.fact: The 2026 run book is a 6-page Word file linked from Coaches Corner; it has typos (Legue, childs, 22rd), two sections numbered 10, a duplicated clearance section, 2026 dates, one coach's real welcome email and a screenshot from a family's account.

Volunteers are cleared every year before any duties: application with photo ID, JDP background check, Abuse Awareness Training. New volunteers give at least three references. Every volunteer is told they are a mandatory reporter under the SafeSport law.
Background checks reset every October 1, and Abuse Awareness Training must be done on or after October 1 to count for the coming season.
Pending JDP checks are canceled after 14 days and can be resent; JDP email can land in junk mail; most checks finish in about one business day.
JDP requires a Social Security number.
Abuse Awareness Training is free and takes about 45 minutes.

BLS volunteer steps: submit the application on the website or during registration, BLS reviews and sends it to JDP, then JDP emails the volunteer. Pick BLS as your associated league for Abuse Awareness Training. Background check questions go to secretary@.
A board member checks the uploaded ID and presses Send Background Check; then JDP emails the volunteer.
Screening information should not be publicly distributed; BLS replaced its public cleared-volunteer table on Nov 2, 2026.
Assistant coaches are not appointed before the draft; managers recommend them after the draft, the president nominates and the board approves.

Draft divisions are Minors, Majors, 50/70 and Juniors; AA, Coach Pitch and Tee Ball teams are formed by school, then age, with the manager's child on the team and one requested assistant; evaluation attendance rules; families hear a day or two after the mid-February draft or in mid-March.
2026 Majors and Minors baseball evaluations: Feb 7 and Feb 9.
2026 softball evaluations: Feb 7 and Feb 10.
2026 Juniors and 50/70 baseball evaluations began Thursday, March 12.
2026 Upper Division (Majors and Minors) coaches meeting: Sun Feb 22, 6 to 8 PM, Round Table Pizza, Bonney Lake.
2026 Juniors, 50/70 and lower division coaches meeting: March 22, 6 to 8 PM, Round Table Pizza, Bonney Lake, with the General Membership Meeting.
Spring 2027 registration opens Friday, Nov 27, 2026, with an opening discount of $50 per family. No end date for the discount and no other 2027 season dates are set.
GameChanger is free for coaches and staff, including premium features; families use team messaging, scheduling and RSVP free.
The Little League Rulebook app is free on iOS and Android and covers baseball, softball and Challenger.
Baseball pitch counts and rest days by league age; softball uses innings limits.
Diamond Leader is free and required once for tournament (All-Star) managers and coaches.
A player suspected of a concussion is removed and returns only with written clearance from a licensed health care provider trained in concussion care.

BLSLL Safety Manual: emergency steps, injury reports within 24 to 48 hours, first aid kits at every game and practice, Safety Code read to players and signed, field hazard check before every event, molded cleats only, never leave an unattended child, only approved coaches run practices.
Home team preps the field (drag, chalk, fence); away team puts equipment away and secures the field (BLS baseball handbook, last updated 1/17/22, posted as the local rules).
Spring gear return list: cleaned gear bags, balls and coach binders.
Gear returns: gear cleaned and keys on the zipper.
In 2026, families booked their team's Opening Day photo slot through a link their coach used.
Uniform order process changed so parents enter personal sizing; socks and belts were added.
2026-27 role emails: pa@, coaching@, secretary@, safety@, scheduler@, equipment@, fields@, uniforms@, info@; the Fields Committee is forming for 2027.
Mandatory reporting: report child abuse, including sexual abuse involving a minor, to the proper authorities within 24 hours.
The Volunteer page shows 'No Programs are Currently Displayed'; the spring 2027 Head Coach, Assistant Coach and Team Volunteer roles are not attached yet.
The live Posted Schedules page lists no 2026 or 2027 programs; a new Schedules & Scores page is planned for the BLS site.
The Medical Release Form is carried by the team manager with the team roster.

Nov 1 board meeting (draft minutes, for approval Dec 6): teams must play 12 games and the league tries to schedule 13 for each division. Spring 2027 registration windows (motion passed): Black Friday sale Nov 27 to 29, $50 off per family; Early Bird Nov 30 to Dec 31, $25 off per family; full price from Jan 1, 2027. Zach Thibodeau is the Softball AA and Coach Pitch Player Agent. The Fields Committee was created to help clean up, clear weeds, set pegs and prepare fields and job boxes, and recruits volunteers. BLS loses storage at the Daffodil shed in late spring when the turf project starts.
